memory_verse.label: Bible Reference
memory_verse.text: "Then Moses summoned Joshua and said to him in the presence of all Israel, 'Be strong and courageous, for you must go with this people into the land the Lord swore to their ancestors to give them, and you must divide it among them as their inheritance.'" — Deut 31:7 (NIV)

devotion.label: Devotion
devotion.text:
Moses now publicly commissions Joshua, speaking the same words of courage over him: "Be strong and courageous." What a gracious moment. Rather than clinging to his position or resenting his successor, Moses openly, generously hands over leadership "in the presence of all Israel." He blesses and strengthens the one who would take his place. There is no rivalry here, only faithful passing on of the torch.

This is a beautiful example for us. God's work is a relay, not a solo race. Each generation of God's people is called to run faithfully and then hand on the baton to those who follow. The wise servant of God does not grasp at their role forever, but invests in and encourages the next generation, gladly making way for them.

Notice too that Moses did not send Joshua out with anxious warnings, but with strengthening words. He built Joshua up, spoke courage into him, publicly affirmed God's call on his life. We can do the same for those coming after us — encouraging younger believers, blessing new leaders, speaking faith and courage into them rather than fear.

Ultimately, every human leader is temporary, pointing beyond themselves to the one Leader who never passes away. Joshua would lead for a time, but Jesus is the great Leader and Shepherd who remains forever (Heb 13:8). So run your leg of the race faithfully, encourage those who follow, and rest in the One whose leadership never ends.

reflection.label: Reflection
reflection.text:
1. Am I willing to invest in and encourage those who come after me?
2. Do I hold my roles with an open hand, ready to pass them on?
3. Who could I speak courage and blessing into this week?

prayer.label: Prayer
prayer.text: Lord, help me run my part of the race faithfully and gladly encourage those who follow. Free me from clinging to my roles, and let me build up the next generation. Thank You for Christ, our Leader forever. Amen.
